findings.claim: Vietnamese phonemization, selectable preset voices, CPU ONNX path and WAV save at 48000 Hz are implemented.
Code metadata version is 3.8.3; 25 packaged presets. Model card observed on web describes SDK 3.7.1 and 23 presets; versions must be reconciled, not mixed.
Selected model/codec downloads omit revision pin; repository voice file may override built-in voices and default; constructor attempts denoiser retrieval even in preset-only lane.
CPU engine accepts local codec_dir, but inspected public V3Turbo constructor does not forward codec_dir. onnx_dir alone does not eliminate codec or preset network paths.
GPU path invokes trust_remote_code=True for tokenizer/codec; auto device/backend selection can change engine. First bounded proof should explicitly select CPU/ONNX.
Naturalness, CVF/acronym/number pronunciation, Windows installation, offline behavior, time/memory/cancel behavior, and actual WAV-to-HyperFrames compatibility are unexecuted.
